full_text:
Article 2 (Goods Subject to Imposition)
Goods subject to anti-dumping duties shall be sodium dithionite (sodium hydrosulfite) originating in China and falling under subheading No. 2831.10.1000 of the Harmonized Tariff and Statistical Classification of Goods referred to in Article 98 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act.
